# spaceman backup

Create, list, verify and restore sealed backups (docs: site/operators/backup.md).

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman backup create`](#spaceman-backup-create) | Write a sealed backup to the configured target (safe while central runs; needs the KEK) |
| [`spaceman backup list`](#spaceman-backup-list) | List the backups in the configured target, newest first |
| [`spaceman backup restore`](#spaceman-backup-restore) | Restore a backup into an empty data directory (offline: central must be stopped; needs the KEK) |
| [`spaceman backup verify`](#spaceman-backup-verify) | Verify a backup: checksums, sealed objects opened with the KEK, database integrity, audit chain |

## spaceman backup create

Write a sealed backup to the configured target (safe while central runs; needs the KEK).

```sh
spaceman backup create [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | bool |  | print the manifest as JSON |

## spaceman backup list

List the backups in the configured target, newest first.

```sh
spaceman backup list [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | bool |  | print JSON |

## spaceman backup restore

Restore a backup into an empty data directory (offline: central must be stopped; needs the KEK).

Restores the database, role memory, recordings, attachments and transcripts. The first start afterwards pauses every space, renews execution authority (lease generations), marks active runs unknown, replays event subscriptions from their oldest stored delivery and revokes approvals with uses left. Resume each space explicitly once its node has reconciled.

```sh
spaceman backup restore ID|DIR [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data` | string |  | data directory to restore into (default: data_dir from the configuration) |
| `--force` | bool |  | move existing data aside (to backups/pre-restore-*) instead of refusing a non-empty target |

## spaceman backup verify

Verify a backup: checksums, sealed objects opened with the KEK, database integrity, audit chain.

```sh
spaceman backup verify ID|DIR [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | bool |  | print JSON |
| `--no-key` | bool |  | check only the checksums of the sealed objects (no KEK needed) |
